negative_controls: Changing the C3 numerator constant from -3 to -4 destroys order three.
The bad birational model has generic different 6 versus special different 4; deleting its extra pole restores the necessary degree 4.
X^r = p has a special point but no point even modulo p^2 for the tested primes and r > 1.
When m = p, the first coefficient of (1+X)^(-1/m) is nonintegral.
Over Z_(3), sqrt(1+2Z) exists in the formal-series ring but translation by 3 would force a rational square root of 7; completeness is required.
For n > 1 the generic order p^n ansatz reduces with kernel of size p^(n-1).
scope: Finite exact diagnostics plus independent proof audit; no solution of the universal problem.
